summary: A man of Cozes who died before December 1666, when his daughter Suzanne was baptized; John's 10th-great-grandfather.
bio: Daniel Delatour lived at Cozes and was John's 10th-great-grandfather. He had died by 19 December 1666, when his daughter Suzanne La Tour was baptized at Cozes and he was described in the register as "the deceased Daniel Delatour".
sources: Kenn True Garner, The French Reformed Church, Cozes, Saintonge: Baptisms 1655-1668 (FamilySearch Books); FHL film 1868505 item 5 p.69
